---
title: "SEEC at a glance"
toc: false
---

```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

source("R/data.R")
source("R/viz.R")
d <- seec_read_data()

updated <- with_tz(Sys.time(), "Africa/Johannesburg")
last_full_year <- current_year - 1

pub_years <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(d$pubs$Year))
grad_last <- sum(d$past_students$`Graduation Year` == last_full_year, na.rm = TRUE)

grant_latest <- tail(seec_grants(d$grantlist)$yearly, 1)

team <- seec_team(d$coreteam)
team_core <- sum(team$Role %in% c("Leadership team", "Core", "Core (postdoc)"))
team_affiliates <- sum(team$Role == "Affiliate")
```

::: last-updated
Last updated `r format(updated, "%d %B %Y, %H:%M %Z")`
:::

::: lead-text
Annual statistics for the Centre for Statistics in Ecology, Environment and Conservation (SEEC), built directly from the SEEC Google Sheets and refreshed automatically each day the sheets change. Select a figure to see the detail.
:::

```{r}
stat_row(
  stat_tile("Registered students", nrow(d$current_students),
            paste(sum(degree_group(d$current_students$Degree) == "Doctorate"), "doctoral"),
            href = "students.html"),
  stat_tile(paste("Graduates in", last_full_year), grad_last,
            paste(nrow(d$past_students), "degrees completed to date"),
            href = "students.html#graduates"),
  stat_tile(paste("Publications in", last_full_year), sum(pub_years == last_full_year, na.rm = TRUE),
            paste(sum(pub_years == current_year, na.rm = TRUE), "so far in", current_year),
            href = "publications.html"),
  stat_tile(paste("Grant funding in", grant_latest$year), fmt_money(grant_latest$total),
            "South African Rand", href = "grants.html"),
  stat_tile("Team", nrow(d$coreteam),
            paste(team_core, "core ·", team_affiliates, "affiliates"),
            href = "team.html")
)
```

## Trends

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="49%"}
::: chart-card
```{r}
pubs_yearly <- tibble(year = pub_years) %>% filter(!is.na(year)) %>% count(year, name = "n")
seec_columns(pubs_yearly, "year", "n",
             title = "Publications per year",
             subtitle = paste(current_year, "in progress"),
             partial = current_year, unit = " publications",
             height = 300)
```
